title: Wall Street Sees SpaceX’s AI Revenue 100 Times Higher by 2030

summary: (Bloomberg) -- Research analysts across Wall Street are telling would-be SpaceX IPO buyers that they’re modeling for the company’s artificial intelligence division to see 100 times revenue growth at the end of the decade, to help justify a targeted $1.8 trillion valuation.Most...

title: Why Meta is delaying its latest AI model release

title: AI Power Boom Revives Natural Gas as Infrastructure Bet
title_zh: 人工智能发电热潮重振天然气作为基础设施的赌注
summary: (Bloomberg) -- A surge in electricity demand from artificial intelligence and data centers is reshaping North America’s power markets, creating a “renaissance” for natural gas after decades of limited new development, according to KKR & Co.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——KKR & Co 表示，人工智能和数据中心带来的电力需求激增正在重塑北美电力市场，在经历了数十年有限的新开发后，为天然气带来了“复兴”。
